plan: [This is the first round, so I have no history to learn from. My value is $25. I want to bid in a way that maximizes my expected profit. A reasonable starting strategy is to bid slightly below my value, say around 80% of my value, to try and win while leaving some profit margin. This will allow me to win if the other bids are low, and avoid overbidding if the other bids are high. So I will bid 0.8 * $25 = $20. ]
